## Inspiration Theme

I often read papers from *The American Biology Teacher* now that I've switched my sub-field from ecology to discipline-based education research. Recently, I was reading a paper from Donkoh, Maruca, and Meir, and was inspired to re-create a 4-panel box-and-whisker plot they had in their article. While the DOI linked above is restricted to members and subscribers of National Associate of Biology Teachers (NABT), I have attached a photo of the figure from a physical copy of the journal I have.

![Figure 1 from Donkoh, Maruca, & Meir (2025). This figure is the inspiration for my simple, custom theme for HW 8.](ABT_Fig1/ABT_Fig1.png)

    First = NULL, 
    CWID = NULL, 
    Extra.credit = NULL, 
    ExamColor = NULL
